_rule: keep iff has_usable_code AND arxiv_date in window

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Mamba-3
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Efficient sequence architectures / post-transformer models
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Improved state-space-model LLM backbone: a more expressive (trapezoidal) recurrence, a complex-valued state-update rule for richer state tracking, and a MIMO formulation that boosts downstream accuracy without increasing decode latency; matches Mamba-2 perplexity with half the state size.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles Through Structured State Space Duality

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Gated DeltaNet-2
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Efficient sequence architectures / linear attention
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Linear-attention sequence layer that decouples erase and write into two independent channel-wise gates, letting the model edit its fixed-size recurrent (compressed KV) memory without scrambling existing associations; trainable on FineWeb-Edu with released code.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Linear attention compresses an unbounded KV cache into a fixed-size recurrent state. The hard part is not just what to forget, but how to edit this compressed memory without scrambling existing associations.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: MiniCPM-SALA
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Efficient sequence architectures / hybrid sparse-linear attention
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: 9B hybrid LLM that interleaves sparse attention (InfLLM-V2) with linear attention (Lightning Attention) at a 1:3 ratio plus hybrid positional encoding, enabling million-token-context inference on consumer GPUs; converts pretrained Transformers to the hybrid via continual training (~75% cheaper than from scratch). Open weights released.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Integrates 25% InfLLM-V2 and 75% Lightning Attention, effectively leveraging the granular focus of sparse attention for local details and the high efficiency of linear attention for broad context.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Parallax (Parameterized Local Linear Attention)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Efficient sequence architectures / linear attention
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: A drop-in upgrade to softmax attention: a scalable, solver-free form of Local Linear Attention that learns a query-like projector probing the KV covariance, with a hardware-aware decode kernel matching/outperforming FlashAttention 2/3; pretrained at 0.6B and 1.7B with consistent perplexity gains.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Parallax is an upgrade to Softmax Attention. It is a scalable form of Local Linear Attention (LLA), a mechanism with provable theoretical advantages over Softmax Attention.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Reverso
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Time-series & forecasting foundation models
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: A family of tiny (0.2M-2.6M param) zero-shot time-series foundation models that interleave long-convolution and linear-RNN (DeltaNet) layers, matching transformer-based forecasters over 100x larger; pushes the performance-efficiency Pareto frontier. Reverso-Small checkpoint released (others 'coming soon').
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: By combining long convolutions with linear RNN layers, Reverso matches the performance of transformer-based models that are over 100x larger.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Toto 2.0
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Time-series & forecasting foundation models
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: An open-weights family of multivariate time-series forecasting foundation models (4M to 2.5B params) trained under one u-muP-scaled recipe, setting state of the art on the BOOM observability benchmark, GIFT-Eval, and the contamination-resistant TIME benchmark; captures multivariate interactions, long context, and cross-domain transfer.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Toto is a foundation model for multivariate time series forecasting with a focus on observability metrics.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: VETime (Vision Enhanced Zero-Shot Time Series Anomaly Detection)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Time-series foundation models / anomaly detection backbone
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Zero-shot time-series anomaly-detection backbone that unifies temporal and visual modalities via reversible image conversion, patch-level temporal alignment, anomaly-window contrastive learning, and task-adaptive multi-modal fusion; superior zero-shot localization with lower compute than vision-based baselines. Pretrained checkpoints released.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: VETime significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models in zero-shot scenarios, achieving superior localization precision with lower computational overhead

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Flow2GAN (Hybrid Flow Matching + GAN, Multi-Resolution Network)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Generative models beyond images (audio)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: High-fidelity audio generation/vocoding from Mel-spectrograms or discrete audio tokens with few-step (even one-step) inference, combining flow matching and GAN training.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Flow2GAN enables high-fidelity audio generation from Mel-spectrograms or discrete audio tokens with efficient few-step (even one-step) inference.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: SGNO: Spectral Generator Neural Operator
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Scientific ML / neural operators (PDE surrogate)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Stable long-horizon autoregressive PDE rollouts via a residual time-stepper using exponential time differencing in Fourier space with a learned diagonal generator; lower long-horizon error than baselines on 1D/2D/3D PDE families.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: SGNO maps the current state and coordinates to the next state through a residual neural operator.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Lance (3B native unified multimodal model for image+video generation/editing)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Generative models beyond images (video)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Single 3B model that performs image and video understanding, generation, and editing including image-to-video (i2v) within one framework; weights released on HuggingFace.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Lance is a 3B native unified multimodal model that supports image and video understanding, generation, and editing within a single framework.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Bernini (MLLM semantic planner + DiT renderer for video generation/editing)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Generative models beyond images (video)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Unified video generation and editing that combines an MLLM-based semantic planner with a DiT-based renderer; inference code and model weights (Bernini-R) released.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Bernini is a unified framework for video generation and editing that combines an MLLM-based semantic planner with a DiT-based renderer.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: E3RelaxH2 (high-degree, high-order equivariant GNN for direct crystal structure optimization)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Graph neural networks / geometric deep learning
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Maps an unrelaxed crystal directly to its DFT-relaxed structure (atomic positions and lattice parameters) in a single equivariant forward pass, avoiding iterative DFT relaxation. Pretrained checkpoints (c2db, mp, xmno) and datasets are released on Zenodo.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: E3RelaxH2 is an E(3)-equivariant graph neural network that predicts relaxed crystal structures (atomic positions and lattice parameters) from unrelaxed inputs in a single forward pass.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: GREPO (graph neural network benchmark + GNN retrievers/rerankers for repository-level bug localization)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Graph neural networks / geometric deep learning
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Provides the first GNN benchmark for repository-scale bug localization (86 Python repos, 47,294 bug-fixing tasks) together with official GNN retriever/reranker training and evaluation code and a dataset on ModelScope, enabling graph-structured code reasoning for software engineering.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: This repository is the official code implementation for the paper 'GREPO: A Benchmark for Graph Neural Networks on Repository-Level Bug Localization'.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Molmo2 (open-weight vision-language model with video understanding and pointing/grounding)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Multimodal & vision-language-action models
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Open-weight VLM family (Molmo2-4B, Molmo2-8B, Molmo2-O-7B) with state-of-the-art point-driven visual grounding across single-image, multi-image, and video tasks; full code, pretrain/SFT checkpoints, and 9 new datasets are released.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Molmo2 is state-of-the-art among open-source models and demonstrates exceptional new capabilities in point-driven grounding in single image, multi-image, and video tasks

usable_fresh_techniques.name: InternVL-U (unified multimodal model for understanding, reasoning, generation, and editing)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Multimodal & vision-language-action models
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: A single lightweight 4B-parameter unified multimodal model that performs multimodal understanding, reasoning, image generation, and image editing in one framework, outperforming prior open-source unified baselines on generation/editing while retaining strong understanding. Inference code and a HuggingFace checkpoint are released.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: InternVL-U is a 4B-parameter unified multimodal model (UMM) that brings multimodal understanding, reasoning, image generation, image editing into a single framework

usable_fresh_techniques.name: VLA Foundry (unified single-codebase framework for training LLM -> VLM -> VLA models)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Multimodal & vision-language-action models
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: An open-source framework unifying LLM, VLM, and VLA training in one shared stack (language pretraining through action-expert fine-tuning), supporting both from-scratch training and HuggingFace pretrained backbones; trained LLM/VLM/VLA model weights (e.g. Foundry-VLA-1.7B-sim) are released on HuggingFace.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: VLA Foundry is an open-source framework that unifies LLM, VLM, and VLA training in a single codebase.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: SIGMA-PPG
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (PPG bio-signals)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Self-supervised PPG foundation model using a Prior-Guided Adversarial Masking mechanism; pretrained on 120,000+ hours of photoplethysmography, it produces general representations that beat five SOTA baselines across 12 downstream health tasks. Pretrained checkpoints released on HuggingFace.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Pre-trained on over 120,000 hours of data, SIGMA-PPG achieves superior average performance compared to five state-of-the-art baselines across 12 diverse downstream tasks.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: PulseLM
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (PPG bio-signals + language)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Multimodal framework pairing PPG signal encoders with LLMs for physiological-signal reasoning; ships a large PPG-text QA dataset (1.31M 10s segments, 3.15M QA pairs across 12 clinical tasks), training/eval code, and model checkpoints + dataset on HuggingFace.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: PulseLM is a multimodal framework that integrates PPG (Photoplethysmography) signal encoders with large language models for physiological signal understanding research.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: SAM-Audio (Segment Anything in Audio)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (audio)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Diffusion-transformer foundation model (Meta) for general audio source separation that unifies text, visual, and temporal-span prompting in one framework; isolates any sound in a mixture. Code installable via pip and checkpoints (sam-audio-large) released on HuggingFace.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: SAM-Audio is a foundation model for isolating any sound in audio using text, visual, or temporal prompts.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Woosh (Sound Effects Foundation Model)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (audio)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Sony AI sound-effects foundation model bundling a high-quality audio encoder/decoder (Woosh-AE), a text-audio alignment model (Woosh-CLAP), and text-to-audio + video-to-audio generative models, including distilled fast-inference variants. Inference code and open weights released.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: This repository provides inference code and open weights for the sound effect generative models developed at Sony AI.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Audio-Omni
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (audio)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: End-to-end framework unifying understanding, generation, and editing across general sound, music, and speech; couples a frozen Qwen2.5-Omni MLLM with a trainable Diffusion Transformer, plus a new 1M-pair AudioEdit dataset. Code on GitHub and model checkpoint on HuggingFace.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: the first end-to-end framework to unify understanding, generation, and editing across general sound, music, and speech domains.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Sparse-BitNet
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Efficient / on-device / small models (extreme quantization + sparsity)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Training/inference framework that combines 1.58-bit (ternary) BitLinear quantization with N:M structured sparsity, showing 1.58-bit LLMs are naturally friendly to semi-structured sparsity for efficient on-device LLMs. Runnable train.py / eval.py / generate.py provided.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Training framework for Sparse-BitNet models -- combining 1.58-bit quantization (BitLinear) with N:M structured sparsity for efficient LLM training and inference.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: Agent Memory Below the Prompt (Persistent Q4 KV Cache)
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Efficient / on-device / small models (edge KV-cache quantization)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Persists each agent's KV cache to disk as 4-bit quantized safetensors and reloads it directly into attention, eliminating redundant prefill for multi-agent LLM inference on edge devices; cuts time-to-first-token by up to 136x and fits 4x more agent contexts in fixed memory vs FP16. Open-source code for Apple Silicon.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: Persistent KV cache for multi-agent LLM systems on Apple Silicon.

usable_fresh_techniques.name: EEG-DLite
usable_fresh_techniques.subfield: Efficient / on-device / small models (data distillation for efficient sensing-model training)
usable_fresh_techniques.capability: Dataset-distillation framework that encodes EEG segments into compact latent representations and filters out noisy/redundant samples, enabling more efficient pre-training of large EEG foundation models on a smaller curated subset (AAAI 2026). Runnable distillation + LaBraM pretraining scripts.
usable_fresh_techniques.verbatim_quote: EEG-DLite is the first systematic framework for pre-training data distillation in EEG foundation models.
